note: Private RV park off US 71 at the south end of Spirit Lake, between the highway and Center Lake in the Iowa Great Lakes; open gravel pull-through rows by the entrance and a wooded older section running west toward Center Lake, with a pool, store and playground. Reservations by phone; the operator's website is a placeholder. --Claude

GOOGLE: 4.2 stars, 265 reviews (Cenla Campgrounds, 3200 US-71, Spirit Lake). Campendium: 5 reviews, the 2017-2025 ones all 5.0. Recent Google reviews read: 'Last minute stay, they were very accommodating...nice people imo. Our rv spot was level.clean...' (5/5, ~5 months ago); 'We wanted to just check out the area for one night they put together two sites so we could do so!' (5/5, a year ago); one Tripadvisor 2/5 a year ago: 'the locals don't have to follow the rules just the travelers'. Only the first page of Google reviews was readable (limited view).

PRICE / PRESENCE: no nightly rate posted anywhere by the operator and no booking engine (phone reservations only). Camper reports: Campendium 'Last Nightly Rate $40 Reported 9/13/24'; review of September 13, 2024: 'for $45 a night its great!'; September 26, 2022 review $35. All under the US$50 gate; no gateway within 40 km. RV Life price_tier 2 ($$) stands as the price indicator. A CAMPER-REPORTED RATE can price an entry only when the operator has no web page: the operator's page is a placeholder with no content, so this is AWH's call; I did not write fees. Presence passes on Google Maps (open, 265 reviews, phone).

LONG-STAY (seasonal evidence, read as long-stay leaning, borderline but not clearly mostly seasonal): Campendium review Sept 14, 2019: 'Most of the spots are taken by seasonal folks - lots of nice rigs.' Sept 13, 2024: 'Lots of permanent party or long rentals but not trashy at all.' July 30, 2025: 'Look forward to staying here a lot during the summer season.' Imagery shows the wooded west section filled with what look like parked seasonal trailers, and open rows by the entrance with ~60 rigs. Five tests: (1) seasonal-only sites: not stated anywhere; (2) no posted nightly rate and no engine, so it FAILS test 2 if AWH reads it as long-stay in character; (3) no homes or lots for sale seen; (4) nightly sales are shown by 2022, 2024 and 2025 one- and two-night reviews and Google's 'one night' review, but the nightly share can't be counted; (5) no short-stays-by-approval rule seen. Google is 4.2 (not under 4), so the automatic drop doesn't apply; with good reviews this doesn't read as 'iffy'.

WATERFRONT LEAD (upward, unconfirmed; left at not waterfront): the stored evidence ('pads set a block back behind a residential strip from Center Lake') holds for the open pull-through rows by the entrance (~150-250 m from the shore behind the Center Lake Drive homes). But the campground's roads continue west into a wooded section (OSM caravan_site node at 43.40823,-95.12995) whose westmost sites sit ~25-50 m from the Center Lake shore under full canopy, with two docks on that stretch, and a July 2025 review says 'you can fish right off the dock.' The canopy hides whether the shore strip is open land and whether those sites are nightly or seasonal, and no operator page or photo shows them, so it stays down. Worth a look if the operator's new site posts a map.

UNSOURCED STORED GROUPS: hookups (50 A/water/sewer), sites (max_rig 75, pull-through), facilities (showers, laundry) and season (year_round false; note's 'mid-April to mid-October') are all derived from old note prose, with no operator page left to confirm them. Campendium lists Full Hookups and Pull thru and a 2024 reported longest vehicle; the 75-ft figure and the season dates are on no current page. Left as recorded.
